import numpy as np
def equation(t, x, v, params):
    p=params
    c=np.cos(p[1]*t); s=np.sin(p[1]*t)
    return (p[0] + p[2]*x + p[3]*x**2 + p[4]*v + p[5]*v**2
            + p[6]*c + p[7]*s + p[8]*v*c + p[9]*v*s)
